title: blast-radius config
description: Policy for blast-radius. In a project's .blast-radius.json, rules can only make decisions stricter.

change.description: Commands that create or modify resources.

destroy.description: Commands that delete or replace resources, or can't be previewed.

default.description: Rules when no environment matches. Built-in: change pass, destroy ask.

environments.description: The first environment with a matching pattern wins.

match.description: Globs (* matches anything, case-insensitive) matched against the terraform workspace, kube context, namespace, cloud profile/project and working directory.

protect.description: Resources that may never be deleted or replaced: terraform addresses (aws_db_instance.*), Kubernetes kind/name or namespace/kind/name.

stateful.description: Extra terraform resource types or Kubernetes kinds that hold data.

audit_log.description: File that gets one JSON line per risky command. Only read from your user config.

audit_all.description: Also record shell commands with nothing risky in them. Only read from your user config.

audit_prompts.description: Set to false to stop recording the requests you give the agent. Default true. Only read from your user config.

audit_redact.description: Mask personal data (emails, phone numbers, PAN, Aadhaar, card numbers, IP addresses) in requests and errors, and secrets everywhere. Default true. Only read from your user config.

audit_retention_days.description: Delete audit log entries older than this many days. 0 keeps them. Only read from your user config.
